speaker_name: Address by Mr. Pravind Kumar Jugnauth
speaker_title: Address by Mr. Pravind Kumar Jugnauth, Prime Minister, Minister for Defense, Home Affairs, and External Communications, Minister for Rodrigues, Outer Islands, and Territorial Integrity of the Republic of Mauritius

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: It is indeed a great pleasure to see you steering the proceedings of the 76th Session of the General Assembly of the United Nations. Mauritius and Maldives share common challenges as developing islands of the Indian Ocean. We wish to assure you of our full cooperation and support during your Presidency.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is indeed a great pleasure to see you steering the proceedings of the 76th 
Session of the General Assembly of the United Nations. Mauritius and Maldives 
share common challenges as developing islands of the Indian Ocean. We wish to 
assure you of our full cooperation and support during your Presidency.

paragraphs.text: I extend my gratitude to H.E. Mr. Volkan Bozkır for his successful Presidency of the last Session.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I extend my gratitude to H.E. Mr. Volkan Bozkır for his successful Presidency 
of the last Session.

paragraphs.text: Let me also congratulate His Excellency Mr. António Guterres upon his re-election as Secretary-General of the United Nations and thank him for his comprehensive report entitled “Our Common Agenda”.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Let me also congratulate His Excellency Mr. António Guterres upon his 
re-election as Secretary-General of the United Nations and thank him for his 
comprehensive report entitled “Our Common Agenda”.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: You have chosen a very appropriate theme for this session given the unique situation we are in for the past 20 months.
paragraphs.raw_text:
You have chosen a very appropriate theme for this session given the unique 
situation we are in for the past 20 months.

paragraphs.text: Building resilience through hope, recovering from COVID-19, rebuilding sustainably, responding to the needs of the planet, respecting the rights of people, and revitalizing the United Nations cover the whole range of activities which are not only urgent but also crucial if we are to ensure our long term continued existence on our planet, in a manner that enhances multilateralism and cooperation, protects the rights of people by reinforcing our institutions and the Rule of Law, and leaves no one behind.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Building resilience through hope, recovering from COVID-19, rebuilding 
sustainably, responding to the needs of the planet, respecting the rights of people, 
and revitalizing the United Nations cover the whole range of activities which are not 
only urgent but also crucial if we are to ensure our long term continued existence on 
our planet, in a manner that enhances multilateralism and cooperation, protects the 
rights of people by reinforcing our institutions and the Rule of Law, and leaves no 
one behind.

paragraphs.text: The COVID-19 pandemic caught a totally unprepared world with unparalleled intensity, disrupting governments and societies, the multilateral system, and more importantly, the lives and livelihood of people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The COVID-19 pandemic caught a totally unprepared world with unparalleled 
intensity, disrupting governments and societies, the multilateral system, and more 
importantly, the lives and livelihood of people.

paragraphs.text: It has brought to light the scale of global interconnectedness. Events in one country can have rippling effects across the globe.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It has brought to light the scale of global interconnectedness. Events in one 
country can have rippling effects across the globe.

paragraphs.text: Almost two years later, we are still grappling with the pandemic and its mutations and despite the fact that vaccines have come out amazingly fast, we are still not in a position to say that life is back to normal.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Almost two years later, we are still grappling with the pandemic and its 
mutations and despite the fact that vaccines have come out amazingly fast, we are 
still not in a position to say that life is back to normal.

paragraphs.text: In fact, just as many countries were finding it hard to find basic protective equipment at the beginning of the pandemic, they are now facing similar challenges to have access to affordable and effective vaccines.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In fact, just as many countries were finding it hard to find basic protective 
equipment at the beginning of the pandemic, they are now facing similar challenges 
to have access to affordable and effective vaccines.

paragraphs.text: While advanced economies have been able to deploy massive fiscal stimulus to cushion the pandemic’s impact and have succeeded in achieving mass vaccinations, the policy response of developing countries has been constrained by several factors, and access to vaccines is still limited.
paragraphs.raw_text:
While advanced economies have been able to deploy massive fiscal stimulus to 
cushion the pandemic’s impact and have succeeded in achieving mass vaccinations, 
the policy response of developing countries has been constrained by several factors, 
and access to vaccines is still limited.

paragraphs.text: Inequitable vaccine distribution is not only leaving millions of people vulnerable to the virus, but it is also allowing new variants to emerge, with the result that recovery will take longer.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Inequitable vaccine distribution is not only leaving millions of people 
vulnerable to the virus, but it is also allowing new variants to emerge, with the result 
that recovery will take longer.

paragraphs.text: We welcome the US initiative to organize a Leaders’ Summit to consider ways of eradicating the Pandemic. The meeting held this week shows that bringing together World Leaders, economic partners, and vaccine producers, and the scientific community can lead to concerted actions to fight the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We welcome the US initiative to organize a Leaders’ Summit to consider 
ways of eradicating the Pandemic. The meeting held this week shows that bringing 
together World Leaders, economic partners, and vaccine producers, and the scientific 
community can lead to concerted actions to fight the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: We should strive towards producing more vaccines, more rapidly, and decentralize their production to cater for the needs of the people around the globe.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We should strive towards producing more vaccines, more rapidly, and 
decentralize their production to cater for the needs of the people around the globe.

paragraphs.text: Multilateral facilities such as the COVAX should be fully funded and empowered to redistribute surplus vaccine doses.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Multilateral facilities such as the COVAX should be fully funded and 
empowered to redistribute surplus vaccine doses.

paragraphs.text: Necessary technology and resources should be shared with developing countries, including SIDS like Mauritius, to enable the roll out of vaccines for faster return to normalcy.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Necessary technology and resources should be shared with developing 
countries, including SIDS like Mauritius, to enable the roll out of vaccines for faster 
return to normalcy.

paragraphs.text: In the same vein, unilateral economic sanctions should be reviewed in light of the humanitarian urgency to fight the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In the same vein, unilateral economic sanctions should be reviewed in light of 
the humanitarian urgency to fight the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: With these initiatives, we stand a good chance to eradicate the pandemic or at the very least, be able to learn to live with it, but the world will still have to face the economic challenge that has come with the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
With these initiatives, we stand a good chance to eradicate the pandemic or at 
the very least, be able to learn to live with it, but the world will still have to face the 
economic challenge that has come with the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: COVID-19 has severely impacted the world economy. Mauritius was not spared and our GDP contracted by 14.9 per cent in 2020.
paragraphs.raw_text:
COVID-19 has severely impacted the world economy. Mauritius was not 
spared and our GDP contracted by 14.9 per cent in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Public health spending has had to be increased significantly, together with a string of measures to assist business transformation, support the tourism sector, increase local food production, and support various sectors of the economy.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Public health spending has had to be increased significantly, together with 
a string of measures to assist business transformation, support the tourism sector, 
increase local food production, and support various sectors of the economy.

paragraphs.text: Along with the pandemic, Mauritius has also faced other challenges concerning its financial services sector, and we have had to address these as a matter of great urgency in order to keep the sector afloat.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Along with the pandemic, Mauritius has also faced other challenges concerning 
its financial services sector, and we have had to address these as a matter of great 
urgency in order to keep the sector afloat.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: Before the pandemic, Small Island Developing States were already facing significant levels of debt distress.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Before the pandemic, Small Island Developing States were already facing 
significant levels of debt distress.

paragraphs.text: While we welcome the G20 Debt Service Suspension Initiative, we believe this facility should be extended to include Small Island Developing States, in particular the Middle-Income Countries as well.
paragraphs.raw_text:
While we welcome the G20 Debt Service Suspension Initiative, we believe this 
facility should be extended to include Small Island Developing States, in particular 
the Middle-Income Countries as well.

paragraphs.text: A new global financial architecture focusing on fiscal space and debt sustainability is urgently needed for SIDS.
paragraphs.raw_text:
A new global financial architecture focusing on fiscal space and debt 
sustainability is urgently needed for SIDS.

paragraphs.text: Mauritius fully supports the proposal to produce a Multidimensional Vulnerability Index to be used in determining the type and measure of support that will be needed by a country, not only to build its resilience, but also to put it on track to achieve its SDGs.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Mauritius fully supports the proposal to produce a Multidimensional 
Vulnerability Index to be used in determining the type and measure of support that 
will be needed by a country, not only to build its resilience, but also to put it on track 
to achieve its SDGs.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: The Paris Agreement was hailed as a major breakthrough in our efforts to tackle climate change, but the climate events since, show that unless we commit to doing much more, our planet, and indeed our existence, are severely threatened.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Paris Agreement was hailed as a major breakthrough in our efforts to 
tackle climate change, but the climate events since, show that unless we commit to 
doing much more, our planet, and indeed our existence, are severely threatened.

paragraphs.text: The last Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change report is unequivocal, we are in the red and human influence is to a large extent responsible for the state of our atmosphere, ocean, and land.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The last Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change report is unequivocal, 
we are in the red and human influence is to a large extent responsible for the state of 
our atmosphere, ocean, and land.

paragraphs.text: The world has great expectations from the COP26 Summit. We all know what needs to be done; it is not sufficient to simply raise ambitions, but more importantly, we need to commit to deliver on them.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The world has great expectations from the COP26 Summit. We all know what 
needs to be done; it is not sufficient to simply raise ambitions, but more importantly, 
we need to commit to deliver on them.

paragraphs.text: We owe this to future generations.
paragraphs.raw_text: We owe this to future generations.

paragraphs.text: Mauritius welcomes the fact that the Green Climate Fund has nearly reached the level of contributions that has been pledged. But this will be meaningless unless access to it is simplified, especially for SIDS.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Mauritius welcomes the fact that the Green Climate Fund has nearly reached 
the level of contributions that has been pledged. But this will be meaningless unless 
access to it is simplified, especially for SIDS.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: Oceans are hosts to huge amounts and varieties of biodiversity that need to be protected.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Oceans are hosts to huge amounts and varieties of biodiversity that need to be 
protected.

paragraphs.text: We support ongoing work for a legally binding instrument on biodiversity beyond national jurisdiction that would allow an equitable sharing of benefits.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We support ongoing work for a legally binding instrument on biodiversity 
beyond national jurisdiction that would allow an equitable sharing of benefits.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: The protection and promotion of human rights and gender equality should remain at the centre of all our endeavours.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The protection and promotion of human rights and gender equality should 
remain at the centre of all our endeavours.

paragraphs.text: We have an immense responsibility towards our future generations. Throughout the world, students and young people have been facing growing frustration because of confinements, education disruptions, and fewer job opportunities.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have an immense responsibility towards our future generations. Throughout 
the world, students and young people have been facing growing frustration because 
of confinements, education disruptions, and fewer job opportunities.

paragraphs.text: Special efforts need to be made to bring them in the mainstream. Mauritius stands ready to support all initiatives in that regard.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Special efforts need to be made to bring them in the mainstream. Mauritius 
stands ready to support all initiatives in that regard.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: One sector which has thrived during the pandemic relates to infodemics and criminal activities in cyberspace. This has to be addressed globally.
paragraphs.raw_text:
One sector which has thrived during the pandemic relates to infodemics and 
criminal activities in cyberspace. This has to be addressed globally.

paragraphs.text: We support the elaboration of an international Convention on Countering the Use of Information and Communications Technologies for Criminal Purposes.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We support the elaboration of an international Convention on Countering the 
Use of Information and Communications Technologies for Criminal Purposes.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: The use of force to legitimize governments is a matter of grave concern to the international community and affects peace and regional stability. We condemn such acts just as much as we condemn the resurgence of violent extremism and terrorism in Africa.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The use of force to legitimize governments is a matter of grave concern to the 
international community and affects peace and regional stability. We condemn such 
acts just as much as we condemn the resurgence of violent extremism and terrorism 
in Africa.

paragraphs.text: We stand in solidarity with the Afghan people and hope that peace prevails and brings stability to the region. We support all regional and international initiatives aimed at finding sustainable peaceful solutions. We also call for a just and lasting settlement for the Palestinian people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We stand in solidarity with the Afghan people and hope that peace prevails 
and brings stability to the region. We support all regional and international initiatives 
aimed at finding sustainable peaceful solutions. We also call for a just and lasting 
settlement for the Palestinian people.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: Mauritius expresses the hope that under your Presidency, the process of reforming the Security Council in order to make it more representative of the new realities will be accelerated.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Mauritius expresses the hope that under your Presidency, the process of 
reforming the Security Council in order to make it more representative of the new 
realities will be accelerated.

paragraphs.text: The historical injustice done to Africa must be corrected. Africa should have its rightful place in an expanded Security Council which should also include a seat for SIDS.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The historical injustice done to Africa must be corrected. Africa should have 
its rightful place in an expanded Security Council which should also include a seat 
for SIDS.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: It remains a matter of concern that more than two years after the International Court of Justice ruled that the decolonization process of Mauritius has not been lawfully completed in view of the unlawful excision of the Chagos Archipelago from its territory prior to independence, and that the United Kingdom has an obligation to withdraw its unlawful administration from the Archipelago as rapidly as possible, we still see no action on the part of the colonial power.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It remains a matter of concern that more than two years after the International 
Court of Justice ruled that the decolonization process of Mauritius has not been 
lawfully completed in view of the unlawful excision of the Chagos Archipelago from 
its territory prior to independence, and that the United Kingdom has an obligation to 
withdraw its unlawful administration from the Archipelago as rapidly as possible, we 
still see no action on the part of the colonial power.

paragraphs.text: And yet, the findings of the ICJ have been affirmed by UN General Assembly Resolution 73/295 and in January this year, a Special Chamber of ITLOS has held that those authoritative determinations of international law by the ICJ have binding legal effect, rendering it beyond legitimate dispute that Mauritius is sovereign over the Chagos Archipelago as an integral part of its national territory.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And yet, the findings of the ICJ have been affirmed by UN General Assembly 
Resolution 73/295 and in January this year, a Special Chamber of ITLOS has held 
that those authoritative determinations of international law by the ICJ have binding 
legal effect, rendering it beyond legitimate dispute that Mauritius is sovereign over 
the Chagos Archipelago as an integral part of its national territory.

paragraphs.text: The ITLOS Special Chamber also underscored that in adopting resolution 73/295, the General Assembly has set out modalities for the completion of the decolonization of Mauritius, which the ICJ has ruled every member of the UN, and UN agency, has an obligation to support.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The ITLOS Special Chamber also underscored that in adopting resolution 
73/295, the General Assembly has set out modalities for the completion of the 
decolonization of Mauritius, which the ICJ has ruled every member of the UN, and 
UN agency, has an obligation to support.

paragraphs.text: The ITLOS Chamber will now proceed to delimit the maritime boundary between Mauritius and Maldives on the basis of Mauritius being the Coastal State in relation to the Chagos Archipelago.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The ITLOS Chamber will now proceed to delimit the maritime boundary 
between Mauritius and Maldives on the basis of Mauritius being the Coastal State in 
relation to the Chagos Archipelago.

paragraphs.text: We note with further satisfaction that Specialized Agencies of the United Nations such as the Universal Postal Union have recently adopted by a large majority a resolution to give practical effect to General Assembly resolution 73/295, thereby ensuring respect for international law and its obligations under the Agreement it signed in 1947 with the UN.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We note with further satisfaction that Specialized Agencies of the United 
Nations such as the Universal Postal Union have recently adopted by a large majority 
a resolution to give practical effect to General Assembly resolution 73/295, thereby 
ensuring respect for international law and its obligations under the Agreement it 
signed in 1947 with the UN.

paragraphs.text: Mauritius looks forward to further implementation of Resolution 73/295 by other international and regional organizations, with the support of UN Member States.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Mauritius looks forward to further implementation of Resolution 73/295 by 
other international and regional organizations, with the support of UN Member 
States.

paragraphs.text: Mauritius remains committed to implementing a programme for the resettlement in the Chagos Archipelago of Mauritian nationals, in particular those of Chagossian origin who were forcibly removed by the UK from the Chagos Archipelago in violation of their basic human rights.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Mauritius remains committed to implementing a programme for the 
resettlement in the Chagos Archipelago of Mauritian nationals, in particular those 
of Chagossian origin who were forcibly removed by the UK from the Chagos 
Archipelago in violation of their basic human rights.

paragraphs.text: I express, on behalf of the Government and people of Mauritius and in particular the Mauritians of Chagossian origin, our sincere gratitude to all the countries that have been supporting us in completing our decolonization and we appeal to the colonial power to comply with the rulings of the international courts and the resolutions of the General Assembly. Compliance with international law is the responsibility of all law-abiding States.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I express, on behalf of the Government and people of Mauritius and in 
particular the Mauritians of Chagossian origin, our sincere gratitude to all the 
countries that have been supporting us in completing our decolonization and we 
appeal to the colonial power to comply with the rulings of the international courts 
and the resolutions of the General Assembly. Compliance with international law is 
the responsibility of all law-abiding States.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: I would like to reiterate the commitment of Mauritius to ensuring the continued operation of the defence facility in Diego Garcia. Mauritius considers the facility vital to the maintenance of international peace and security in the Indo-Pacific region, and to efforts to combat terrorism, piracy, and the illicit trafficking of drugs and persons.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would like to reiterate the commitment of Mauritius to ensuring the continued 
operation of the defence facility in Diego Garcia. Mauritius considers the facility vital 
to the maintenance of international peace and security in the Indo-Pacific region, and 
to efforts to combat terrorism, piracy, and the illicit trafficking of drugs and persons.

paragraphs.text: In this regard, Mauritius, as sovereign over the Chagos Archipelago, which includes Diego Garcia, stands ready to enter into a long-term arrangement with the United States in respect of Diego Garcia.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this regard, Mauritius, as sovereign over the Chagos Archipelago, which includes 
Diego Garcia, stands ready to enter into a long-term arrangement with the United 
States in respect of Diego Garcia.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: With regard to Tromelin which also forms an integral part of the territory of Mauritius, we call for the early resolution of the dispute over the island in the spirit of friendship that characterizes the relations between Mauritius and France.
paragraphs.raw_text:
With regard to Tromelin which also forms an integral part of the territory of 
Mauritius, we call for the early resolution of the dispute over the island in the spirit 
of friendship that characterizes the relations between Mauritius and France.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: We can no longer afford to be fractious. We need to promote, preserve, and strengthen multilateralism.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We can no longer afford to be fractious. We need to promote, preserve, and 
strengthen multilateralism.

paragraphs.text: Together, we can build more sustainable, equal societies and economies.
paragraphs.raw_text: Together, we can build more sustainable, equal societies and economies.

paragraphs.text: Together, we can transform our world into one that recognizes and respects the dignity of every human being.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Together, we can transform our world into one that recognizes and respects the 
dignity of every human being.

paragraphs.text: I thank you.
paragraphs.raw_text: I thank you.
